verdict.rationale: Every first-party doc excerpt describes what Grok can do, and the per-model page is explicitly a specification card, not a safety or system card. Nothing documents what the model is bad at. The only stated limits are API constraints ('Reasoning cannot be disabled', guarantees only for 'supported schema features'), not model failure modes. Failure modes appear only in community reports (premature 'Done!' claims, timeouts on numeric calculation), which do not count, because the story asks what the vendor documents in its own docs.
